email_body:
Hi Sterling HR team,

I am applying for the Graduate Engineer role in your Rockhampton office, advertised on SEEK (job 95194344). Your careers page invites resume and cover letter to this inbox, so I am sending both here.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer and then field engineer, reviewing drawings, doing inspections and quality checks, and coordinating crews, subcontractors and suppliers. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card and an Australian driver licence with transport, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I am available for site, regional and Central Queensland travel.

The mix of office and field work on civil asset renewal, inspections, quality documentation and project coordination is the pathway I want. I do not yet hold a Rail Industry Worker card; I am ready to obtain one if required.

Could we talk about the role? I have attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineer position based in your Rockhampton office, advertised on SEEK. The role covers civil asset renewal and maintenance with a mix of office and field work, including inspections, engineering investigations, project coordination and quality documentation across Central Queensland.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. In that diploma I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries as part of design work.

From April 2019 to September 2019 I was project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, coordinating daily crews and reviewing drawings against the work. From September 2019 to February 2020 I was field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works, assisting with inspections, material records and progress reports.

I live in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card and an Australian driver licence with reliable transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site and regional travel in Central Queensland. I do not yet hold a Rail Industry Worker card and would complete that induction if you need it.
I have attached my resume. Portfolio drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Happy to discuss how I could support your Rockhampton team.
